Air Pollution and the Airborne Diseases: Evidence from China and Japan
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: This paper estimates the impact of ambient air pollution on the two most economically costly airborne respiratory diseases, COVID-19 and influenza. Our methods incorporate the epidemiological Susceptible-Infectious-Recovered-Deceased (SIRD) model to construct the outcome of interest, the Instrumental Variable (IV) model to establish causality, and the Flexible Distributed Lag (FDL) model to capture dynamic effects. Analyzing data from the first wave of the COVID-19 pandemic in China, we find that air pollution can significantly raise the daily growth rate of COVID-19. In contrast, air pollution shows small and statistically insignificant effects on influenza healthcare visits in Japan.
abstract_zh: 本文估计环境空气污染对两种经济成本最高的空气传播呼吸道疾病——COVID-19和流感——的影响。我们的方法包括：构建结果变量时采用流行病学的易感-感染-康复-死亡（SIRD）模型；为建立因果关系采用工具变量（IV）模型；为捕捉动态效应采用灵活分布滞后（FDL）模型。利用中国COVID-19大流行第一波的数据，我们发现空气污染会显著提高COVID-19的每日增长率。相比之下，空气污染对日本流感就诊次数的影响很小且在统计上不显著。

Clean Water and Infant Health: Evidence from Piped Water Provision in China
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: We examine the impact of clean drinking water on infant mortality in China using a novel instrumental variable: the least-cost distance of piped water infrastructure between water sources and infant mortality surveillance areas. We find that the provision of piped water significantly decreases infant mortality, with a 10 percentage point increase in piped water coverage reducing infant mortality by 15%. Compared with regions with highly polluted surface waters, access to piped water is particularly beneficial in regions with slightly polluted surface waters, in which the pollution is difficult to observe. A simple cost-benefit analysis indicates that the benefits of piped water provision in rural China significantly outweigh the estimated costs.
abstract_zh: 我们利用一个新颖的工具变量——水源与婴儿死亡率监测区之间自来水基础设施的最低成本距离——考察清洁饮用水对中国婴儿死亡率的影响。我们发现，自来水供应显著降低了婴儿死亡率：自来水覆盖率每提高10个百分点，婴儿死亡率下降15%。与地表水高度污染的地区相比，自来水在地表水轻度污染的地区尤为有益，因为这类污染难以察觉。简单的成本收益分析表明，中国农村地区自来水供应的收益显著超过所估算的成本。

title: Energy Saving May Kill: Evidence from the Fukushima Nuclear Accident
abstract: Following the Fukushima nuclear accident, Japan gradually shut down all its nuclear power plants, causing a countrywide power shortage. In response the government launched large-scale energy-saving campaigns to reduce electricity consumption. Exploiting the electricity-saving targets across regions and over time, we show that the campaigns significantly increased mortality, particularly during extremely hot days. The impact is primarily driven by people using less air conditioning, as encouraged by the government. Nonpecuniary incentives can explain most of the reduction in electricity consumption. Our findings suggest there exists a trade-off between climate change mitigation and climate change adaptation. (JEL I12, L94, L98, Q48, Q54, Q58)
abstract_zh: 福岛核事故之后，日本逐步关停了全部核电站，引发了全国范围的电力短缺。政府为此发起了大规模的节能运动以减少用电。利用各地区和各时期的节电目标差异，我们表明，这些运动显著提高了死亡率，尤其是在极端炎热的日子里。影响主要来自人们减少使用空调，而这正是政府所鼓励的。非金钱激励可以解释大部分用电量的减少。我们的发现表明，气候变化减缓与气候变化适应之间存在权衡。（JEL I12, L94, L98, Q48, Q54, Q58）

title: How Do Everyday-Low-Price Supermarkets Adjust Their Prices?
Reducing Single-Use Cutlery with Green Nudges: Evidence from China's Food Delivery Industry
abstract: Rising consumer demand for online food delivery has increased the consumption of disposable cutlery, leading to plastic pollution worldwide. In this work, we investigate the impact of green nudges on single-use cutlery consumption in China. In collaboration with Alibaba’s food-delivery platform, Eleme (which is similar to Uber Eats and DoorDash), we analyzed detailed customer-level data and found that the green nudges—changing the default to “no cutlery” and rewarding consumers with “green points”—increased the share of no-cutlery orders by 648%. The environmental benefits are sizable: If green nudges were applied to all of China, more than 21.75 billion sets of single-use cutlery could be saved annually, equivalent to preventing the generation of 3.26 million metric tons of plastic waste and saving 5.44 million trees.
abstract_zh: 消费者对网上外卖需求的增长，增加了一次性餐具的消费，导致了全球范围内的塑料污染。在这项工作中，我们研究了绿色助推（green nudges）对中国一次性餐具消费的影响。我们与阿里巴巴的外卖平台饿了么（类似于Uber Eats和DoorDash）合作，分析了详细的客户层面数据，发现绿色助推——将默认选项改为“不需要餐具”，并以“绿色积分”奖励消费者——使不需要餐具的订单份额提高了648%。环境效益相当可观：如果将绿色助推应用于全中国，每年可节省超过217.5亿套一次性餐具，相当于减少了326万公吨塑料废弃物的产生，并节约了544万棵树。

iEarth: an interdisciplinary framework in the era of big data and AI for sustainable development
abstract: The Intelligent Earth (iEarth) framework, composed of four major themes: iEarth data, science, analytics, and decision, is proposed to define and build an interdisciplinary and synergistic framework for research, practice, and education that simultaneously safeguards the sustainable development of our living planet.
abstract_zh: 智能地球（iEarth）框架由四大主题构成：iEarth数据、科学、分析与决策。该框架旨在界定并构建一个跨学科且协同的研究、实践与教育体系，以同时保障我们这颗生命星球的可持续发展。

title: Can Technology Solve the Principal-Agent Problem? Evidence from China's War on Air Pollution
abstract: We examine the introduction of automatic air pollution monitoring to counter suspected tampering at the local level, a central feature of China’s “war on pollution.” Exploiting 654 regression discontinuity designs based on city-level variation in the day that monitoring was automated, we find an immediate and lasting increase of 35 percent in reported PM10 concentrations post-automation. Moreover, automation’s introduction increased online searches for face masks and air filters, which are strong predictors of purchases. Overall, our findings suggest that the biased and imperfect information prior to automation led to suboptimal investments in defensive measures, plausibly imposing meaningful welfare costs. (JEL D82, O13, P28, Q53, Q55, Q58)
abstract_zh: 我们考察了为应对地方层面涉嫌篡改数据的问题而引入自动化空气污染监测的情况，这是中国“污染防治攻坚战”的一个核心特征。利用基于城市层面自动化监测启用日期差异构建的654个断点回归设计，我们发现，自动化之后，报告的PM10浓度立即且持久地上升了35%。此外，自动化的引入还增加了对口罩和空气过滤器的网络搜索，而这些搜索是购买行为的有力预测指标。总体而言，我们的发现表明，自动化之前有偏且不完善的信息导致了防御性措施投资的次优，可能带来了可观的福利损失。（JEL D82, O13, P28, Q53, Q55, Q58）

China's War on Pollution: Evidence from the First Five Years
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: The decade from 2010 to 2019 marked a significant turning point in China’s history of environmental regulation and pollution. This article describes the recent trends in air and water quality, with a focus on the five years since China declared a “war on pollution” in 2014. It summarizes the emerging literature that has taken advantage of accompanying improvements in data availability and accuracy to document sharp improvements in environmental quality, especially local air pollution, and understand their social, economic, and health consequences.
abstract_zh: 2010年至2019年的十年，是中国环境规制与污染历史上的重要转折点。本文描述了近期空气和水质的变化趋势，重点关注中国于2014年宣布“向污染宣战”以来的五年。文章总结了一批新兴文献，这些文献利用数据可得性和准确性的同步提升，记录了环境质量（尤其是当地空气污染）的显著改善，并考察了其社会、经济和健康后果。

Watering Down Environmental Regulation in China
abstract: This article estimates the effect of environmental regulation on firm productivity using a spatial regression discontinuity design implicit in China's water quality monitoring system. Because water quality readings are important for political evaluations and the monitoring stations only capture emissions from their upstream regions, local government officials are incentivized to enforce tighter environmental standards on firms immediately upstream of a monitoring station, rather than those immediately downstream. Exploiting this discontinuity in regulation stringency with novel firm-level geocoded emission and production data sets, we find that immediate upstream polluters face a more than 24% reduction in total factor productivity (TFP), and a more than 57% reduction in chemical oxygen demand emissions, as compared with their immediate downstream counterparts. We find that the discontinuity in TFP does not exist in nonpolluting industries, only emerged after the government explicitly linked political promotion to water quality readings, and was predominantly driven by prefectural cities with career-driven leaders. Linking the TFP estimate with the emission estimate, a back-of-the-envelope calculation indicates that China's water regulation efforts between 2000 and 2007 were associated with an economic cost of more than 800 billion Chinese yuan.
abstract_zh: 本文利用中国水质监测系统中隐含的空间断点回归设计，估计环境规制对企业生产率的影响。由于水质读数对政治考核十分重要，而监测站仅能捕捉其上游地区的排放，地方政府官员有动机对紧邻监测站上游的企业执行更为严格的环境标准，而非对紧邻下游的企业。利用新颖的企业层面地理编码排放与生产数据，我们发现，与紧邻下游的同类企业相比，紧邻上游的污染企业全要素生产率（TFP）下降超过24%，化学需氧量（COD）排放下降超过57%。我们发现，TFP的断点在非污染行业中并不存在，且仅在政府明确将政治晋升与水质读数挂钩之后才出现，并主要由具有职业晋升导向的领导所在的地级市所驱动。将TFP估计值与排放估计值结合起来，粗略的估算表明，2000至2007年间中国的水环境治理努力所对应的经济成本超过8000亿元人民币。

title: Avoidance Behavior against Air Pollution: Evidence from Online Search Indices for Anti-PM2.5 Masks and Air Filters in Chinese Cities
Do College Graduates Serving as Village Officials Help Rural China?
New Evidence on the Impact of Sustained Exposure to Air Pollution on Life Expectancy from China's Huai River Policy
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract:
This paper's findings suggest that an arbitrary Chinese policy that greatly increases total suspended particulates (TSPs) air pollution is causing the 500 million residents of Northern China to lose more than 2.5 billion life years of life expectancy. The quasi-experimental empirical approach is based on China’s Huai River policy, which provided free winter heating via the provision of coal for boilers in cities north of the Huai River but denied heat to the south. Using a regression discontinuity design based on distance from the Huai River, we find that ambient concentrations of TSPs are about 184 μg/m
3
[95% confidence interval (CI): 61, 307] or 55% higher in the north. Further, the results indicate that life expectancies are about 5.5 y (95% CI: 0.8, 10.2) lower in the north owing to an increased incidence of cardiorespiratory mortality. More generally, the analysis suggests that long-term exposure to an additional 100 μg/m
3
of TSPs is associated with a reduction in life expectancy at birth of about 3.0 y (95% CI: 0.4, 5.6).
abstract_zh: 本文的研究结果表明，中国一项任意的政策大幅增加了总悬浮颗粒物（TSPs）空气污染，使中国北方5亿居民的预期寿命损失超过25亿年。准实验实证方法以中国的淮河政策为基础，该政策向淮河以北的城市提供用于锅炉的煤炭并免费供应冬季取暖，而淮河以南则不提供供暖。利用基于与淮河距离的断点回归设计，我们发现北方的TSPs环境浓度约高出184 μg/m³（95%置信区间：61，307），即高出55%。此外，结果表明，由于心肺疾病死亡率上升，北方居民的出生时预期寿命约低5.5年（95%置信区间：0.8，10.2）。更一般地，分析表明，长期暴露于每增加100 μg/m³的TSPs，与出生时预期寿命减少约3.0年相关（95%置信区间：0.4，5.6）。

title: Particulate Air Pollution and Mortality in 38 of China's Largest Cities: Time-Series Analysis
abstract: Objectives To estimate the short term effect of particulate air pollution (particle diameter 200 million). Participants 350 638 deaths (200 912 in males, 149 726 in females) recorded in 38 city districts by the Disease Surveillance Point System of the Chinese Center for Disease Control and Prevention from 1 January 2010 to 29 June 2013. Main outcome measure Daily numbers of deaths from all causes, cardiorespiratory diseases, and non-cardiorespiratory diseases and among different demographic groups were used to estimate the associations between particulate air pollution and mortality. Results A 10 µg/m3 change in concurrent day PM10 concentrations was associated with a 0.44% (95% confidence interval 0.30% to 0.58%) increase in daily number of deaths. Previous day and two day lagged PM10 levels decreased in magnitude by one third and two thirds but remained statistically significantly associated with increased mortality. The estimate for the effect of PM10 on deaths from cardiorespiratory diseases was 0.62% (0.43% to 0.81%) per 10 µg/m3 compared with 0.26% (0.09% to 0.42%) for other cause mortality. Exposure to PM10 had a greater impact on females than on males. Adults aged 60 and over were more vulnerable to particulate air pollution at high levels than those aged less than 60. The PM10 effect varied across different cities and marginally decreased in cities with higher PM10 concentrations. Conclusion Particulate air pollution has a greater impact on deaths from cardiorespiratory diseases than it does on other cause mortality. People aged 60 or more have a higher risk of death from particulate air pollution than people aged less than 60. The estimates of the effect varied across cities and covered a wide range of domain.
abstract_zh: 目的：估计颗粒物空气污染（颗粒直径 200 million）对短期死亡的影响。研究对象：2010年1月1日至2013年6月29日，中国疾病预防控制中心疾病监测点系统在38个城区记录的350,638例死亡（男性200,912例，女性149,726例）。主要结局指标：采用全因、心肺疾病、非心肺疾病的每日死亡人数，以及不同人口学群体的每日死亡人数，估计颗粒物污染与死亡率之间的关联。结果：当日PM10浓度每变化10 µg/m³，每日死亡人数增加0.44%（95%置信区间为0.30%至0.58%）。前一日和滞后两日的PM10水平所带来的效应分别减弱了三分之一和三分之二，但仍与死亡率增加保持显著的统计关联。PM10每变化10 µg/m³，对心肺疾病死亡的影响为0.62%（0.43%至0.81%），而对其他原因死亡的影响为0.26%（0.09%至0.42%）。PM10暴露对女性的影响大于男性。在高污染水平下，60岁及以上的成年人比60岁以下的成年人更为脆弱。PM10的效应在不同城市间存在差异，且在PM10浓度较高的城市中略有下降。结论：颗粒物空气污染对心肺疾病死亡的影响大于对其他原因死亡的影响。60岁及以上人群因颗粒物污染而死亡的风险高于60岁以下人群。效应估计在各城市间存在差异，且范围较广。

title: Surface Water Pollution and Infant Mortality in China
The Effect of Air Pollution on Mortality: Evidence from the 2008 Beijing Olympic Games
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: By exploiting exogenous variations in air quality during the 2008 Beijing Olympic Games, we estimate the effect of air pollution on mortality in China. We find that a 10 percent decrease in PM10 concentrations reduces the monthly standardized all-cause mortality rate by 8 percent. Men and women are equally susceptible to air pollution risks. The age groups for which the air pollution effects are greatest are children under 10 years old and the elderly.
abstract_zh: 利用2008年北京奥运会期间空气质量的外生变化，我们估计了空气污染对中国死亡率的影响。我们发现，PM10浓度降低10%，可使月度标准化全因死亡率降低8%。男性和女性对空气污染风险的敏感度相当。空气污染效应最大的年龄组是10岁以下的儿童和老年人。

title: Growth, Pollution, and Life Expectancy: China from 1991-2012
abstract: This paper examines the relationship between income, pollution, and mortality in China from 1991-2012. Using first-difference models, we document a robust positive association between city-level GDP and life expectancy. We also find a negative association between city level particulate air pollution exposure and life expectancy that is driven by elevated cardiorespiratory mortality rates. The results suggest that while China's unprecedented economic growth over the last two decades is associated with health improvements, pollution has served as a countervailing force.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了1991—2012年间中国收入、污染与死亡率之间的关系。利用一阶差分模型，我们记录了城市层面GDP与预期寿命之间稳健的正相关关系。我们还发现，城市层面的颗粒物空气污染暴露与预期寿命之间存在负相关，这一关系由心肺死亡率的上升所驱动。结果表明，中国过去二十年空前的经济增长与健康改善相关，而污染则起到了抵消作用。

title: Does Customer Auditing Help Chinese Workers?
